name: How long does interior window casing installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior window casing installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trimming a single standard window typically takes one to two hours for measuring, cutting, and nailing, while trimming all the windows in an average home usually requires one to three days. Timelines expand if your rough openings require custom jamb extensions to bring the frame flush with existing drywall. Staining and clear-coating natural wood trim also takes longer than painting pre-primed profiles, as each coat requires adequate drying time between applications. Having an on-site finish carpenter handle both trim carpentry and subsequent painting or caulking streamlines the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single window usually takes 1 to 2 hours to trim, while a full house of windows typically takes 1 to 3 days depending on prep and finishing requirements.
